news.title: Canary Technologies Named to Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for Third Consecutive Year
Canary Technologies Named to the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for a Third Consecutive Year
Canary Technologies Study Examines AI’s Impact on the Hotel Guest Experience

bullets: Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for Canary's third-party integrations across reservation platforms, payment gateways, and other adjacent hospitality integrations.
Serve as the platform product manager for integrations across all Canary products, defining shared frameworks and reusable APIs so product teams can connect to any partner system…
Prioritize the integration roadmap based on customer demand, enterprise brand requirements, and revenue impact.
Own the relationships with integration partners including technical scoping, testing + certification, and managing each partnership across the integration lifecycle.
Partner with product teams to ensure integrations meet each product's needs while keeping the underlying platform consistent and maintainable.

roles.title: Director of Product, Digital Guest Journey

bullets: Own the product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Digital Guest Journey — defining what gets built, what doesn't, and why.
Proactively diagnose high-impact opportunities by synthesizing signals from customers, data, sales, and the competitive landscape.
Maintain direct, ongoing relationships with hotel operators and enterprise clients to shorten feedback loops and sharpen prioritization between formal research cycles.
Translate product decisions into business narratives connecting product metrics to company-level outcomes including revenue, margin, and churn.
Lead technical conversations with engineering and enterprise clients with precision, including system architecture, integration dependencies, and trade-offs.
